Metadata.GlobalAvailability: DermGPT is available for dermatologists and is free to use [SOURCE 3].
Metadata.Summary: DermGPT is an AI chatbot developed by Dr. Faranak Kamangar to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and save time for physicians [SOURCE 3, SOURCE 4]. It utilizes a curated database of peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 3, SOURCE 4].
Metadata.Keywords: AI; dermatology; chatbot; clinical efficiency; peer-reviewed articles; patient education; prior authorization; telehealth

UsesAndDirections.IntendedUseAndWorkflow: DermGPT is intended to assist dermatologists and their staff in everyday practice by providing quick access to information, answering clinical queries, looking up data, answering patient questions, and accessing handouts [SOURCE 4]. It assists with medication options, summarizing guidelines, suggesting labs, automating documentation, writing insurance letters, creating patient handouts, and providing informed consent language [SOURCE 4].
UsesAndDirections.PrimaryIntendedUsers: The primary intended users are dermatologists, RNs, MAs, and ancillary staff [SOURCE 4].
UsesAndDirections.NecessaryKnowledgeExpertise: DermGPT is intended as an assistant and should be paired with a dermatology provider or staff who can complement its skills with their higher-level creative problem-solving skills [SOURCE 4].
UsesAndDirections.HowToUse: DermGPT allows dermatologists to ask questions in natural language and receive relevant, helpful answers [SOURCE 4]. Dermatologists can sign up at dermgpt.com [SOURCE 3].
UsesAndDirections.TargetedPatientPopulation: DermGPT targets dermatologists treating a general patient population [SOURCE 3].
UsesAndDirections.PatientConsentOrDisclosureRequiredOrSugg: DermGPT provides informed consent language regarding procedures and telehealth consults.

Warnings.DeveloperSuppliedWarnings: DermGPT does not replace medical care or decision-making; it should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker but as an assistant [SOURCE 4].
Warnings.ModelLimitations: The con of any AI tool is that it is not a human, nor is it trying to be. AI tools excel in efficient and data-driven tasks, but they lack human creativity, intuition, and the ability to think outside the box. DermGPT is most powerful when paired with a dermatology provider or staff who can complement its skills with their higher-level creative problem-solving. It should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker, but as an assistant. [SOURCE 4]

TrustIngredients.AISystemFacts: DermGPT is an AI chatbot built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles. It aims to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and help save time for physicians. [SOURCE 3, 4]
TrustIngredients.InteractionWithOtherSystems: DermGPT can integrate with existing EHR systems to streamline documentation and facilitate seamless information exchange. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.OutcomesAndOutput: DermGPT provides healthcare providers a quick reference for medication options, dosing, and interactions; summarizes diagnosis and treatment guidelines for complex cases; suggests appropriate labs, imaging, and procedures for diagnostic workups; automates documentation such as visit notes, orders, and prescriptions; writes insurance authorization letters; creates patient handouts regarding drugs, after-care, and more; summarizes a provider’s medical notes; assists with study guides for Board Exams; provides informed consent language regarding procedures and telehealth consults. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.TypeAndValueOfSolutionOutput: DermGPT delivers relevant, helpful answers in natural language to dermatologists' questions, similar to real-life colleagues. It provides quick access to dermatology information, diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria. It also supports patient management with educational handouts and prescription programs. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.ExplanationForHowAnOutputIsGenerated: DermGPT pulls information from a proprietary database of trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals, unlike general language models like ChatGPT. [SOURCE 3, 4]
TrustIngredients.InputDataSource: DermGPT is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles. [SOURCE 3]
TrustIngredients.DevelopmentDataCharacterization: DermGPT's database consists of trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals related to dermatology. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.TrainingData: DermGPT is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles.
TrustIngredients.DatasetTransparency: DermGPT only pulls from trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals.
TrustIngredients.RelevanceOfTrainingDataToIntendedPopulat: DermGPT is trained on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles specific to dermatology, aiming to ensure relevance and reliability for dermatologists.
TrustIngredients.BiasMitigationApproaches: DermGPT uses a proprietary database sourced from trusted, physician-approved sources to avoid the errors and hallucinations that can occur with general language models like ChatGPT.
TrustIngredients.OngoingMaintenance: The DermGPT platform is continuously updated and improved. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.TransparencyInformation: DermGPT pulls information from trusted, physician-approved sources, unlike ChatGPT, which may not be scientifically sound. It is trained with chat, reasoning, writing abilities, and customized with a highly expert-curated dermatology-specific database. [SOURCE 4]

UsefulnessEfficacy.GoalOfMetrics: The goal is to save dermatologists time and improve access to dermatologic data, leading to more efficient patient care, decreased wait times, and less physician burnout.
UsefulnessEfficacy.Result: DermGPT has been used for various tasks, including prior authorizations, denial letters, resident board study, and patient education handouts.
UsefulnessEfficacy.Interpretation: The tool streamlines clinical tasks and makes dermatology information readily available, saving time for physicians and staff.
UsefulnessEfficacy.TestType: The platform is designed with an intuitive user interface to ensure ease of use.
UsefulnessEfficacy.TestingDataDescription: DermGPT is continuously updated and improved to remain the most up-to-date source of material.
UsefulnessEfficacy.ValidationProcessAndJustification: DermGPT is validated by its use in creating dermatology verbiage for various applications, providing reliable and trustworthy information.

Resources.StakeholdersConsultedDuringDesignOfSolut: Episode 10 of The Future of Dermatology Podcast features a discussion with Vishi Hawkes, MBA, of Regeneron, about barriers, stakeholders, and connections between patients, doctors, and others involved in personal healthcare. [SOURCE 1]
